title: Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16709v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models have recently solved open Erd\H{o}s problems and achieved gold-medal level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. But their solutions, written in natural language, cannot yet be verified by proof assistants. An erroneous reasoning step can invalidate every step that comes after, so it is advantageous to detect errors early. Several methods have been proposed to detect erroneous reasoning quickly based on the features of the forward pass of the language model that performs reasoning. In this work, we study whether the directed Forman curvature of that model's attention graph, a local quantity computed at an edge from the attention weights around it, carries information about a step's correctness. translated_title: 用于数学推理验证的注意力图曲率
translated_abstract: 语言模型最近解决了公开的埃尔德什问题，并在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛题目上达到了金牌水平的表现。但它们以自然语言书写的解答尚无法被证明助手验证。一个错误的推理步骤可能使其后的所有步骤失效，因此尽早检测错误是有利的。已有若干方法被提出，基于执行推理的语言模型前向传递特征来快速检测错误推理。在本工作中，我们研究该模型注意力图的有向Forman曲率——一种在边上根据其周围注意力权重计算得到的局部量——是否携带关于某一步骤正确性的信息。为此，我们在ProcessBench上对四个逐步验证器进行了评估，分别测试了在输入中附加曲率值和不附加曲率值两种情况。附加曲率值提升了所有四个验证器的整体平均性能。
tldr: 本研究提出利用语言模型注意力图的有向Forman曲率作为推理步骤正确性的信号，实验表明将该曲率附加到逐步验证器的输入中可显著提升其在ProcessBench上的数学推理验证性能。
en_tdlr: The directed Forman curvature of a language model's attention graph carries information about the correctness of reasoning steps, and appending these curvature values to per-step verifiers' inputs improves their verification performance on ProcessBench.
